paragraphs.text: Rey-Goor , the Black Bayou, was a location on Mirrodin .

The forests extending from the Tangle to the Mephidross gradually become more oil-soaked and gloomy until the ground sloughs away into a stinking bog. The twisted and dying trees send metal root-spikes above the black water and act like islands of solid ground in the sucking vastness of the bayou. The bayou was the home of the Bleak Coven clan of vampires .
The creatures of Rey-Goor weren't exempt from Phyrexianization , as shown by Putrefax .
